newsitem.title: UK: Hague favourite to take over from UK's Major.
newsitem.headline: Hague favourite to take over from UK's Major.

text.p: Welsh Secretary William Hague is 3-1 favourite to take over from Prime Minister John Major as leader of Britain's Conservative Party if, as expected, it loses the May 1 election, bookmakers William Hill said on Monday.
Defence Secretary Michael Portillo is 4-1 with Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine and Home Secretary Michael Howard quoted at 5-1.

William Hill quotes the opposition Labour Party at 1-8 to win the election and 7-1 to win 91-99 seats. The Conservatives are quoted at 9-2 and a hung parliament, where no party has a majority, at 5-1.
